The fix is commit `949b8a17` (TRUNK-6643, merged as PR #6150, authored by jwnasambu on 2026-06-02). It made the wizard's create-database, drop-user, create-user and grant-privileges blocks treat `jdbc:mariadb` the same as `jdbc:mysql`, which were the only cases handled before. The same commit also made `isCurrentDatabase` `protected` so the new unit tests can call it, and added the MariaDB InnoDB session-variable check in `DatabaseUpdater`.

The code lines below are from the commit itself (`949b8a17`), not from the current default branch, where the line numbers have shifted:

- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1169-1171`: `isCurrentDatabase`, changed from `private` to `protected`.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1418`: database creation now accepts MariaDB.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1473`: drop-user statement now accepts MariaDB.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1482`: create-user statement now accepts MariaDB.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:1499`: the GRANT ALL privileges step now accepts MariaDB.
- `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/util/DatabaseUpdater.java:486`: the InnoDB storage-engine hack now also applies to `jdbc:mariadb` URLs.
- `openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterE2ETest.java:834-846`: new tests for the MariaDB and MySQL URL cases.

Related but not the fix: TRUNK-6481 (`dfc573e3`, "mariadb support") and TRUNK-6393 (`b090b21f`, "include mariadb driver") came earlier and added the driver and support in other places. TRUNK-6650 (`d8af2880`, "Fix mariadb command") is a later follow-up on the same theme, and TRUNK-6780 (PR #6474) added a MariaDB option to the test harness. I did not open the diffs of those.
